options.content: ${cdn_filter}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  hdx_cdn as cdn, 
  cnt_all AS Total
FROM ${table} 
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
GROUP BY cdn

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=CDN Hit Count; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    (SUM(cache_hit) / (SUM(cache_hit) + SUM(cache_miss))) AS total
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        countMergeIf(`count()`, cache_was_cached = 1) AS cache_hit,
        countMergeIf(`count()`, cache_was_cached = 0) as cache_miss
    FROM 
        ${table}
    WHERE 
        $__timeFilter(timestamp)
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
)

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache Hit Total %; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  time,
  (SUM(cache_hit) / (SUM(cache_hit) + SUM(cache_miss))) AS total
FROM 
(
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    countMergeIf(`count()`, cache_was_cached = 1) AS cache_hit,
    countMergeIf(`count()`, cache_was_cached = 0) as cache_miss
  FROM 
    ${table}
  WHERE 
    timestamp > toDateTime($__to/1000) - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE AND timestamp < now()
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
  GROUP BY time
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache Hit Rate %; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    timestamp AS time,
    (CASE WHEN cache_was_cached = 1 THEN response_total_bytes ELSE 0 END * 8) /${seconds} AS cache_throughput_bps
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, cache_was_cached
ORDER BY time

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache Throughput; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  timestamp AS time,
  toString(response_status_code) as HTTP_Status_Code,
  cnt_all as http
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
GROUP BY 
  HTTP_Status_Code, time
ORDER BY time

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Hits per Status Code (All); du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    toString(client_asn) as ASN,
    response_total_bytes AS Total
FROM
   ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND notEmpty(client_asn)
    AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
GROUP BY
    ASN
ORDER BY
    Total DESC
LIMIT 100

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Delivered Bytes by ASN; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS time,
    (100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, response_status_code >= '200' AND response_status_code < '300')) / cnt_all AS "2xx_Percent",
    (100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, response_status_code >= '300' AND response_status_code < '400')) / cnt_all AS "3xx_Percent",
    (100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, response_status_code >= '400' AND response_status_code < '500')) / cnt_all AS "4xx_Percent",
    (100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, response_status_code >= '500' AND response_status_code < '600')) / cnt_all AS "5xx_Percent"
FROM 
    ${table}

    $__timeFilter(timestamp)

    time
